arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. A gassy smell needs treating as an emergency, even if it only happens sometimes. Please: don't use the oven or hob, don't use any flames or light switches near it, open the windows, and leave the flat. Then call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If you are ever in immediate danger, call 999. We are arranging an urgent gas safety check and will also look at the oven not heating properly. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked. We will update you today.
